prompt:
Substantially redesign and repaint image 5 into ONE landscape 16:9 hand-painted anime game skin. Image 1 is authoritative HEIXIANG face and physique, images 2/3/4 are brushwork only. Image 5 is only the burgundy winter hunting banquet theme, not its face or rendering.

NEW FRAMING: eye-level medium seated portrait head to just below bent knees; face large in upper central-left. No giant foreground boots, no low-angle feet. Huge muscular man sits leaning slightly forward, chest turned toward viewer. His left arm holds a modest-sized DARK GRAY hunting falcon on a leather glove at chest height on viewer right; right thumb and index finger just lifted a small BURGUNDY LEATHER FALCON HOOD off its head, visible thin strap dangling. Bird calmly looks toward him. His powerful hands perform this delicate action, his original playful tooth-showing smirk meets viewer. Remove held champagne glass. Falcon preparing for ceremonial winter hunt is the clear single story.

EXACT FACE from image 1, adjusted naturally to angle: original cheek breadth, chin length, nose length, brow-eye spacing and lively amber almond eye shape; dark gray-brown tan skin, thick brows, compact stitched scar HIS LEFT cheek/viewer right. Original confident smirk showing a little upper teeth, compact anime nose and mouth, not the elongated older aristocrat face of image 5. Black short slicked-back hair, forehead fully exposed, shaved sides, broad silver-gray frontal lock. Immense shoulders, thick neck and arms with original adult head/body ratio.

COSTUME NEW HIERARCHY: deep burgundy tailored long hunting dress coat, asymmetric fastened right lapel/open left lapel revealing a dark warm-gray waistcoat and the structure of his big chest; narrow ivory shirt collar with a SMALL folded cream tie, no huge ruffled cravat. SMALL ivory fur capelet only over his right shoulder/viewer left, ONE gold falcon clasp. Opposite coat shoulder exposed, chest not buried in fur. Charcoal trousers, boots outside frame. Broad structured cuffs, one tasteful gold border band; leather falcon-hood pouch and slender practical belt. Omit brocade pattern, stacked brooches, chest clasp rows and tassel clusters. Big strong shoulder/chest silhouette, small asymmetric fur accent, clear hands.

BACKGROUND and FOCAL CONTROL: quiet lodge terrace, dark muted blue-gray snow pines, one soft warm window, sparse burgundy curtain edge, stone ledge with readable top/side planes. No broad white snow panorama. Face gets soft upper-left warm main light, clean cool shadow, brightest and clearest detail around amber eyes and cheek. Dark falcon/quiet background secondary. Consistent perspective, occlusion and contact.

PAINTING: match style 2/3/4 with broad opaque directional curved and elongated strokes, quiet solid base-color fields, decisive grouped hard-edge shadows, handmade overlaps and broken stroke endings. Burgundy coat has a few long dark fold sweeps following torso and cloth, NOT a tiny triangular surface mosaic. Fur is 4-6 broad curved ivory masses with a few tapered edges; dark falcon in broad chest/wing groups, no dense feather network. Leather, velvet, fur, metal differentiated through form and sparse highlights. Faces/eyes and fingertips selectively precise, simple anime facial marks. Muted colored grays, concentrated burgundy and warm gold, no uniform muddy gray wash. Environment broad sparse softer shapes, not photography or strong fog. No glossy beauty gradients, 3D, airbrush, noise filter, micro-facet patchwork, evenly traced vector outlines, writing or watermark. Completely reconstruct composition and painting language; do not slightly polish image 5.
review: 重新组织为解下猎鹰眼罩的近景；去巨靴/白裤/酒杯焦点，单肩毛饰，面部更大。毛饰仍偏大，部分笔触仍细碎，待老板审阅，未接入。
